images.prompt: Full-body front view of an original stylized 3D game character in a strict T-pose, arms straight out to the sides, palms down, legs apart. A 28-year-old Black man roller skater with brown skin, a high-top fade haircut, a short neat beard. Short teal track jacket zipped over a white tee, navy knee-length shorts, white knee pads, teal wristbands. High-top black quad roller skates with four teal wheels each and white toe stops. Cel-shaded, clean shapes, no logos, no text.
